title: AROMA4EMS: Code and Data for Autonomous Reward Optimization via Multi-Agent Review for Energy Management Systems in Fuel Cell Electric Vehicles
description: Code, data and run records for the manuscript "AROMA4EMS: Autonomous Reward Optimization via Multi-Agent Review for Energy Management Systems in Fuel Cell Electric Vehicles" (submitted to IEEE Transactions on Transportation Electrification). It contains the fuel cell electric vehicle simulation model, the soft actor-critic energy management system, the dynamic-programming and rule-based benchmarks, the AROMA4EMS multi-agent LLM reward-optimization workflow, the driving cycles and component maps, the records of the eight reward searches reported in the paper, the evaluation tables, and the notebooks that produce the paper figures.
